explanation: Alexey Pajitnov wrote it at a computer centre in Moscow. He built the name from tetra, Greek for four, because every piece has four squares, and tennis, his favourite sport.

claims.text: Alexey Pajitnov created Tetris in 1984 in Moscow, in the Soviet Union.
Tetris was not created in Japan, the United States or Hungary.
Pajitnov worked at a computer centre of the Soviet Academy of Sciences in Moscow when he wrote Tetris.
The name Tetris combines tetra, the Greek prefix for four, with tennis, Pajitnov's favourite sport.
Every Tetris piece is made of four squares.
